text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Nobody here? I was sure I heard 
someone calling me."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Hm, the statue of the Three Goddesses?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The great three who laid the foundation of 
Umamusume history— Could it really be 
them?
